# VelaGuard 告警页 UI 调查报告

## 0. Which "alarm page" is actually affected

The firmware HMI is compiled from `gui/main/ui` into `velaguard-lvgl` (`app/velaguard/Makefile:80-120`, `VG_UI_DIR`, `-DVG_HMI_BOARD=1`; entry `app/velaguard/vg_hmi.c`). There is exactly one page per id (`gui/main/ui/pages/vg_pages.h`) and only ONE alarm-count label in the whole GUI.

Key clarification: the page titled 「告警详情」 (`VG_PAGE_ALARM`, `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_alarm.c`) is a **single-alarm detail view** (6 fixed metric rows, title = alarm title). The model holds only one `s_alarm` struct (`vg_model.c:39`). The page matching the bug report — "count in the title, list of 3 alarm points" — is the **Home page (首页) with the 「告警」 filter chip active** (`vg_page_home.c`): the chip 「告警 3」 is the only live alarm count in the codebase, and the filtered sensor grid below is the "list of 3 rows". (The 旧 detail page itself updates fine on recovery — `refresh_alarm` shows 「无活动告警」.)

## 1. File paths + line numbers

**Alarm-related pages**
- `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_alarm.c` — page create `vg_page_alarm_create` (221-318); title label created 253-255; live refresher `refresh_alarm` (43-183, title set at 65/80/170); model listener registered 316, initial refresh 317; cleanup `on_alarm_delete` 199-204.
- `gui/main/ui/pages/vg_page_home.c` — ctx 19-29; **count chips** `refresh_filter_chips` (58-79, 「告警 %u」 at 68); **list signature** `build_list_sig` (89-109); in-place tile refresh `set_tile_value` (112-128) / `update_tile_texts` (207-226); **list population** `rebuild_list` (228-273, `lv_obj_clean` at 242, rows built 261-268); per-change refresher `refresh_home` (275-283); filter tap `on_filter` (285-292); cleanup `on_home_delete` (327-332); create 367-446 (listener 444, initial refresh 445).

**Model (the stale piece)**
- `gui/main/ui/model/vg_model.c`
  - cached filtered index `s_filt_idx/s_filt_n` (66-67); `notify_all` (69-75); listener cap `VG_MAX_LISTENERS 8` (16)
  - **`rebuild_filter()` (135-175)** — the ONLY writer of the home list membership; called only from `apply_scenario` (851, 1147 — PC sim), `vg_model_set_home_filter` (1201-1206), `vg_model_import_mthings` (1500), `vg_model_import_discover_slaves` (1556), `vg_model_import_runtime_points` (1568, 1628). **NOT called from the live-data path.**
  - `vg_model_count_by_filter` (1210-1223) — counts **live** from `s_sensors` (this is why the chip count is always fresh)
  - `vg_model_home_sensor_at/count` (1193-1199) — reads the cached `s_filt_idx`
  - `vg_model_tick` (1330-1358) — 1 Hz driver: `vg_ui_backend_apply_live()` → `if(dirty) notify_all()`
  - **`vg_model_set_live` (1664-1823)** — per-point update; **recovery path 1707-1715** (clears `s_alarm`, logs 「告警恢复」), severity change 1728-1731, offline 1788-1810. Returns `changed`; **never calls `rebuild_filter()`**.

**App → GUI data flow**
- `app/velaguard/vg_hmi.c` — `main` (104-178): `vg_app_init()` (155), `vg_ui_backend_acq_start()` (168), LVGL loop 170-175.
- `app/velaguard/vg_ui_backend_board.c` — acq thread `vg_hmi_acq_thread` (619-714, 200 ms Modbus poll → `g_live_v/g_live_on`); **`vg_ui_backend_apply_live` (743-801)**: optional point-table re-import when gen changes (749-752 → `import_live_to_model` 527-565 → `vg_model_import_runtime_points`), per-point `vg_model_set_live` (762-766), `pending_alarm.txt` write/clear (768-798, `CONFIG_VG_AGENT_OPS`; note: the GUI never READS this file — pop-up is driven by model state, not the file).
- `gui/main/ui/shell/vg_shell.c` — 1 Hz model timer `s_model_tmr` (212) → `vg_model_tick`; `model_changed` (85-89) → status chips; **page switching `vg_nav_goto` (404-429) / `vg_nav_back` (431-448) → `create_page` (330-384)**: `lv_obj_clean(s_content)` destroys the old page (fires `LV_EVENT_DELETE` → page unregisters its model listener), then `vg_page_xxx_create` re-registers and does an initial refresh — this is the "page-enter rebuild" path.

## 2. Current update flow on alarm-state change (page visible)

```
acq thread (200ms): Modbus poll -> g_live_v[]/g_live_on[]
LVGL timer (1s): vg_model_tick()
  └─ vg_ui_backend_apply_live()          [board]
       ├─ (gen changed?) import_live_to_model() -> vg_model_import_runtime_points()
       │      └─ rebuild_filter() + notify_all()          <-- only path that refreshes list membership
       ├─ for each point: vg_model_set_live(i, v, online)
       │      ├─ severity/online update on s_sensors[i]
       │      ├─ recovery: clear s_alarm, log 「告警恢复」   <-- returns changed=true
       │      └─ (no rebuild_filter(), no notify here)
       └─ return changed
  └─ if(dirty) notify_all()
       ├─ shell: refresh 「告警!」 chip                    (live, correct)
       ├─ home: refresh_home()
       │    ├─ refresh_filter_chips() -> vg_model_count_by_filter()   <-- counts s_sensors directly
       │    │     -> chip 「告警 3」->「告警 2」 IMMEDIATELY        (matches bug: count refreshes)
       │    └─ rebuild_list(false) -> build_list_sig() reads vg_model_home_sensor_count()
       │          = STALE s_filt_n (still 3, same ids) -> sig unchanged
       │          -> update_tile_texts() only -> grid keeps 3 rows  (matches bug: list stale)
       └─ alarm detail page: refresh_alarm() -> 「无活动告警」       (correct)
```

Root cause: **`s_filt_idx/s_filt_n` is only rebuilt on filter switch or point-table import; severity/online changes from `vg_model_set_live` never rebuild it, while the chip count is computed fresh each notify.**

Caveat worth verifying on target: per the code, literally leaving and re-entering Home rebuilds the grid from the *same* stale index (it would still show 3). The actions that actually repair membership are (a) tapping a filter chip (`vg_model_set_home_filter` → `rebuild_filter`) — e.g. toggling 全部→告警， which may be what "switch away and back" was — or (b) a point-table re-import (gen bump, e.g. after `vgpoint apply`). Either way the fix below covers all paths.

## 3. Where the in-place refresh should hook in (minimal fix)

**Model layer, one line — recommended:** make the live path rebuild the filter index before notifying, e.g. in `vg_model_tick()` (`vg_model.c:1344-1348`):

```c
dirty = vg_ui_backend_apply_live();
dirty |= vg_model_board_poll_net();
if(dirty) rebuild_filter();   /* keep s_filt_idx in sync with severity/online */
...
if(dirty) notify_all();
```
(or call `rebuild_filter()` inside `vg_model_set_live` just before `return changed`). Cost is an insertion sort over ≤64 points at 1 Hz — negligible on the H750. No UI change needed: the existing sig mechanism in `vg_page_home.c:236-242` will then detect the changed membership (ids/count) and do `lv_obj_clean` + rebuild automatically. Alternative (UI-side) is to have the home page compute its visible set on demand like `vg_model_count_by_filter` does, instead of the cached index — more invasive.

**Existing helpers to reuse:**
- Signature-gated rebuild + in-place value refresh: `build_list_sig` / `rebuild_list` / `update_tile_texts` (`vg_page_home.c:89-273`) — the house pattern for list pages.
- Simplest full-rebuild-on-change pattern: `vg_page_logs.c` `rebuild_logs`/`refresh_logs` (51-82) with `lv_obj_clean(list)` (15-19).
- If a future multi-alarm list page is wanted, note the model currently supports only ONE `s_alarm`; "N alarm points" exists only as per-point `severity` (`vg_alarm_eval` results), enumerable like `vg_model_count_by_filter`.

## 4. Allocation/leak notes

- Home grid tiles and logs rows are dynamically allocated `lv_obj_t` children. Rebuilds are safe: `lv_obj_clean` (`vg_page_home.c:242`, `vg_page_logs.c:18`) deletes children before repopulating; tile user_data holds the value label pointer (`vg_page_home.c:177`) and the click callback's `s->id` points into the static `s_sensors` array (no dangling heap).
- Every page unregisters its model listener via `LV_EVENT_DELETE` (`on_home_delete` 327-332, `on_alarm_delete` 199-204, `on_logs_delete` 84-86); `create_page`'s `lv_obj_clean` fires those events, so the 8-slot listener array (`vg_model.c:16,1244-1268`) doesn't leak across navigation. Any new refresh path should keep the same register-on-create / unregister-on-delete symmetry.

# Development Workflow

---

## Core Principles

1. **Plan before code** — figure out what to do before you start
2. **Specs injected, not remembered** — guidelines are injected via hook/skill, not recalled from memory
3. **Persist everything** — research, decisions, and lessons all go to files; conversations get compacted, files don't
4. **Incremental development** — one task at a time
5. **Capture learnings** — after each task, review and write new knowledge back to spec

---

## Trellis System

### Developer Identity

On first use, initialize your identity:

```bash
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/init_developer.py <your-name>
```

Creates `.trellis/.developer` (gitignored) + `.trellis/workspace/<your-name>/`.

### Spec System

`.trellis/spec/` holds coding guidelines organized by package and layer.

- `.trellis/spec/<package>/<layer>/index.md` — entry point with **Pre-Development Checklist** + **Quality Check**. Actual guidelines live in the `.md` files it points to.
- `.trellis/spec/guides/index.md` — cross-package thinking guides.

```bash
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/get_context.py --mode packages   # list packages / layers
```

**When to update spec**: new pattern/convention found · bug-fix prevention to codify · new technical decision.

### Task System

Every task has its own directory under `.trellis/tasks/{MM-DD-name}/` holding `task.json`, `prd.md`, optional `design.md`, optional `implement.md`, optional `research/`, and context manifests (`implement.jsonl`, `check.jsonl`) for sub-agent-capable platforms.

```bash
# Task lifecycle
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py create "<title>" [--slug <name>] [--parent <dir>]
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py start <name>          # set active task (session-scoped when available)
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py current --source      # show active task and source
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py finish                # clear active task (triggers after_finish hooks)
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py archive <name>        # move to archive/{year-month}/
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py list [--mine] [--status <s>]
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py list-archive

# Code-spec context (injected into implement/check agents via JSONL).
# `implement.jsonl` / `check.jsonl` are seeded (empty) on `task create` for sub-agent-capable
# platforms; the AI curates real spec + research entries during planning. `validate` fails
# and `start` refuses while a seeded manifest is still empty — sub-agents would run with
# zero spec context. Pass `start --allow-empty-context` when that is intentional.
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py add-context <name> <action> <file> <reason>
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py list-context <name> [action]
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py validate <name>

# Task metadata
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py set-branch <name> <branch>
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py set-base-branch <name> <branch>    # PR target
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py set-scope <name> <scope>

# Hierarchy (parent/child)
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py add-subtask <parent> <child>
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py remove-subtask <parent> <child>

# PR creation
python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py create-pr [name] [--dry-run]
```

> Run `python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py --help` to see the authoritative, up-to-date list.

**Current-task mechanism**: `task.py create` creates the task directory and (when session identity is available) auto-sets the per-session active-task pointer so the planning breadcrumb fires immediately. `task.py start` writes the same pointer (idempotent if already set) and flips `task.json.status` from `planning` to `in_progress`. # Field-test fixes 2026-09-13

Four issues found during hardware testing against the MThings Modbus simulator.

## 1. Online/offline counts flap while all points are online

Root causes (verified):
- `vg_discover_poll_points` does one read per point, `VG_DISC_BYTE_TO_MS=20` is tighter than the alarm reader path (50 ms), no retry -> transient frame failures.
- Acq cycle is ~1-3 s but `vg_model_tick` samples the same `g_live_on` snapshot at 1 Hz, so one real failed poll is counted 2-5x in the 8-slot offline window and `fail_streak`; recovery is instant. Counts oscillate.

Fix: byte timeout 20->50 ms; one immediate retry per failed point read (reuse `VG_DISC_RETRY_INTER_MS`); add `g_live_cycle` counter bumped once per completed acq cycle, `vg_ui_backend_apply_live` applies each cycle exactly once (point-table gen check stays before the dedupe).

## 2. Home alarm list stale after a point recovers

`vg_model.c` caches the home filter index (`s_filt_idx/s_filt_n`), rebuilt only on filter switch / point-table import. Chip counts are computed live via `vg_model_count_by_filter`, so the count updates but list membership (and therefore `build_list_sig`) stays stale.

Fix: call `rebuild_filter()` in `vg_model_tick` when dirty, before `notify_all()`.

## 3. Report page refresh button + MiMo regeneration on demand

- Refactor `vg_page_report.c` read+render into `report_reload()`; header row (trend-page pattern) with a 64x36 primary button labeled 刷新.
- If no valid daily report: show 生成中 hint, disable button, poke the agent heartbeat, poll every 2 s for up to 180 s; timeout shows a hint and re-enables the button. Delete the lv_timer on page delete; ignore repeat clicks while generating.
- Backend: new `request_daily_report` in `vg_ui_backend` (PC mock: unsupported). Board impl writes `/data/agent/HEARTBEAT.poke` (under `CONFIG_VG_AGENT_OPS`).
- Public tree `packages/ai_agent` (branch `velaguard/*`, PR to dev-ai-contest-2026 per BOUNDARY C2): heartbeat thread sleeps in 5 s slices and consumes `AGENT_HEARTBEAT_POKE_FILE` to run `heartbeat_send()` immediately. Direct `heartbeat_trigger()` call from HMI is unsafe pre-daemon-init (message bus has no init guard).

## 4. Status bar date after the title (user-confirmed option A)

`vg_shell.c`: date label right after `s_title` (before the spacer), small/muted font; `clock_cb` refreshes it every second as `|26-9-13` (%d-%d-%d, 2-digit year).

## Acceptance

1. With all points online on the simulator, home 正常/离线 chips stable for 5+ min; unplugging 485 trips offline in ~10 s, plugging back recovers instantly.
2. On the 告警 filter, returning one point to normal shrinks the list within 2-3 s without page switching.
3. Refresh with no daily report enters the generating state and shows the new report within ~1-2 min; timeout gives a clear hint and a clickable button.
4. Status bar reads VelaGuard|26-9-13 on Home (per current date); subpage titles keep their name followed by the date.

## Validation

`bash scripts/build.sh` (TARGET=velaguard-lvgl) compiles both the contest repo and `packages/ai_agent` changes. Board acceptance per `velaguard-board-inner-loop`.
